ayahs.2: Is kitaab ka utaarna Allah Taala ghalib hikmat wale ki taraf se hai.
ayahs.3: Hum ne aasmaanon aur zameen aur un dono ke darmiyaan ki tamaam cheezon ko behtareen tadbeer ke saath hi ek muddat-e-muayyan ke liye paida kiya hai, aur kaafir log jis cheez se daraaye jaate hain munh mod lete hain.
ayahs.4: Aap keh dijiye! Bhala dekho to jinhein tum Allah ke siwa pukaarte ho mujhe bhi to dikhaao ke unhon ne zameen ka kaun sa tukda banaaya hai ya aasmaanon mein un ka kaun sa hissa hai? Agar tum sachche ho to is se pehle hi ki koi kitaab ya koi ilm hi jo naql kiya jaata ho, mere paas laao.
ayahs.5: Aur is se badh kar gumraah aur kaun hoga? Jo Allah ke siwa aison ko pukaarta hai jo qayamat tak us ki dua qabool na kar saken balke un ke pukaarne se mehaz bekhabar hon.
ayahs.6: Aur jab logon ko jama kiya jaayega to yeh un ke dushman ho jaayenge aur un ki parastish se saaf inkaar kar jaayenge.
ayahs.7: Aur unhein jab hamari waazeh aayatein padh kar sunaayi jaati hain to munkir log sachchi baat ko jab ke un ke paas aa chuki, keh dete hain ke yeh to sareeh jaadu hai.
ayahs.8: Kya woh kehte hain ke ise to us ne khud ghad liya hai? Aap keh dijiye! Ke agar main hi ise bana laaya hoon to tum mere liye Allah ki taraf se kisi cheez ka ikhtiyaar nahi rakhte, tum is (Quran) ke baare mein jo kuch keh sun rahe ho ise Allah khoob jaanta hai, mere aur tumhare darmiyaan gawaahi ke liye wohi kaafi hai, aur woh bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.9: Aap keh dijiye! Ke main koi bilkul anokha Paighambar to nahi na mujhe yeh maaloom hai ke mere saath aur tumhare saath kya kya kiya jaayega. Main to sirf isi ki pairwi karta hoon jo meri taraf wahi bheji jaati hai aur main to sirf alal-aalaan aagaah kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.10: Aap keh dijiye! Agar yeh (Quran) Allah hi ki taraf se ho aur tum ne ise na maana ho aur Bani Israeel ka ek gawaah is jaisi ki gawaahi bhi de chuka ho aur woh imaan bhi laa chuka ho aur tum ne sarkashi ki ho, to beshak Allah Taala zaalimon ko raah nahi dikhaata.
ayahs.11: Aur kaafiron ne imaan-daaron ki nisbat kaha ke agar yeh (deen) behtar hota to yeh log is ki taraf hum se sabaqat karne na paate, aur chunke unhon ne Quran se hidayat nahi paayi pas yeh keh denge ke qadeemi jhoot hai.
ayahs.12: Aur is se pehle Moosa ki kitaab peshwa aur rehmat thi. Aur yeh kitaab hai tasdeeq karne wali Arabi zabaan mein taake zaalimon ko daraaye aur nekokaaron ko bashaarat ho.
ayahs.13: Beshak jin logon ne kaha ke hamara Rabb Allah hai phir is par jame rahe to un par na to koi khauf hoga aur na ghamgeen honge.
ayahs.14: Yeh to ahl-e-jannat hain jo sada isi mein rahenge, un aamaal ke badle jo woh kiya karte the.
ayahs.15: Aur hum ne insaan ko apne maan baap ke saath husn-e-sulook karne ka hukm diya hai, us ki maan ne ise takleef jhel kar pet mein rakha aur takleef bardaasht karke ise jana. Us ke hamal ka aur us ke doodh chhudaane ka zamaana tees maheene ka hai. Yahaan tak ke jab woh pukhtagi aur chaalees saal ki umr ko pahuncha to kehne laga aye mere Parwardigaar! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri is nemat ka shukr baja laaun jo tu ne mujh par aur mere maan baap par inaam ki hai aur yeh ke main aise nek amal karoon jin se tu khush ho jaaye aur tu meri aulaad bhi saaleh bana, main teri taraf ruju karta hoon aur main musalmaanon mein se hoon.
ayahs.16: Yehi woh log hain jin ke nek aamaal to hum qabool farma lete hain aur jin ke bad-aamaal se darguzar kar lete hain, (yeh) jannati logon mein hain. Us sachche waade ke mutaabiq jo un se kiya jaata tha.
ayahs.17: Aur jis ne apne maan baap se kaha ke tum se main tang aa gaya, tum mujh se yehi kehte rahoge ke main marne ke baad phir zinda kiya jaaunga, mujh se pehle bhi ummatein guzar chuki hain, woh dono Janab-e-Baari mein fariyadein karte hain aur kehte hain tujhe kharaabi ho tu imaan le aa, beshak Allah ka waada haq hai, woh jawaab deta hai ke yeh to sirf aglon ke afsaane hain.
ayahs.18: Woh log hain jin par (Allah ke azaab ka) waada saadiq aa gaya, un jinnaat aur insaanon ke girohon ke saath jo un se pehle guzar chuke hain, yaqeenan yeh nuqsaan paane wale the.
ayahs.19: Aur har ek ko apne apne aamaal ke mutaabiq darje milenge taake unhein un ke aamaal ke poore badle de aur un par zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.20: Aur jis din kaafir jahannam ke sire par laaye jaayenge (kaha jaayega) tum ne apni nekiyan dunya ki zindagi mein hi barbaad kar dein aur un se faaide utha chuke, pas aaj tumhein zillat ke azaab ki saza di jaayegi, is baais ke tum zameen mein na-haq takabbur kiya karte the aur is baais bhi ke tum hukm-udooli kiya karte the.
ayahs.21: Aur Aad ke bhai ko yaad karo, jabke us ne apni qaum ko Ahqaaf mein daraaya aur yaqeenan is se pehle bhi daraane wale guzar chuke hain aur is ke baad bhi yeh ke tum siwaaye Allah Taala ke aur kisi ki ibaadat na karo, beshak main tum par bade din ke azaab se khauf khaata hoon.
ayahs.22: Qaum ne jawaab diya, kya aap hamare paas is liye aaye hain ke hamein apne maboodon (ki parastish) se baaz rakhen? Pas agar aap sachche hain to jis azaab ka aap waada karte hain ise hum par laa daalen.
ayahs.23: (Hazrat Hood ne) kaha (is ka) ilm to Allah hi ke paas hai, main to jo paighaam de kar bheja gaya tha woh tumhein pahuncha raha hoon lekin main dekhta hoon ke tum log naadaani kar rahe ho.
ayahs.24: Phir jab unhon ne azaab ko ba-soorat-e-baadal dekha apni waadiyon ki taraf aate hue to kehne lage, yeh abr hum par barasne wala hai, (nahi) balke darasal yeh abr woh (azaab) hai jis ki tum jaldi kar rahe the, hawa hai jis mein dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.25: Jo apne Rabb ke hukm se har cheez ko halaak kar degi, pas woh aise ho gaye ke bajuz un ke makaanat ke aur kuch dikhaai na deta tha. Gunahgaaron ke giroh ko hum yunhi saza dete hain.
ayahs.26: Aur bilyaqeen hum ne (qaum-e-Aad) ko woh maqdoor diye the jo tumhein to diye bhi nahi aur hum ne unhein kaan aankhein aur dil bhi de rakhe the. Lekin un ke kaanon aur aankhon aur dilon ne unhein kuch bhi nafa na pahunchaaya jabke woh Allah Taala ki aayaton ka inkaar karne lage aur jis cheez ka woh mazaaq udaaya karte the wohi un par ulat padi.
ayahs.27: Aur yaqeenan hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bastiyan tabaah kar dein aur tarah tarah ki hum ne apni nishaaniyaan bayaan kar dein taake woh ruju kar len.
ayahs.28: Pas qurb-e-Ilahi haasil karne ke liye unhon ne Allah ke siwa jin jin ko apna mabood bana rakha tha unhon ne un ki madad kyun na ki? Balke woh to un se kho gaye, (balke darasal) yeh un ka mehaz jhoot aur (bilkul) bohtan tha.
ayahs.29: Aur yaad karo! Jabke hum ne jinon ki ek jamaat ko teri taraf mutawajjeh kiya ke woh Quran sunen, pas jab (Nabi ke) paas pahunch gaye to (ek doosre se) kehne lage khaamosh ho jaao, phir jab padh kar khatam ho gaya to apni qaum ko khabardaar karne ke liye waapas laut gaye.
ayahs.30: Kehne lage aye hamari qaum! Hum ne yaqeenan woh kitaab suni hai jo Moosa (Alaihis-Salaam) ke baad naazil ki gayi hai jo apne se pehli kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai jo sachche deen ki aur raah-e-raast ki taraf rahnumaai karti hai.
ayahs.31: Aye hamari qaum! Allah ke bulaane wale ka kaha maano, is par imaan laao, to Allah tumhare gunaah bakhsh dega aur tumhein alamnak azaab se panaah dega.
ayahs.32: Aur jo shakhs Allah ke bulaane wale ka kaha na maanega pas woh zameen mein kahin (bhaag kar Allah ko) aajiz nahi kar sakta, na Allah ke siwa aur koi is ke madadgaar honge, yeh log khuli gumraahi mein hain.
ayahs.33: Kya woh nahi dekhte ke jis Allah ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko paida kiya aur un ke paida karne se woh na thaka, woh yaqeenan murdon ko zinda karne par qaadir hai? Kyun na ho? Woh yaqeenan har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.34: Woh log jinhon ne kufr kiya jis din jahannam ke saamne laaye jaayenge (aur un se kaha jaayega ke) kya yeh haq nahi hai? To jawaab denge ke haan qasam hai hamare Rabb ki (haq hai) (Allah) farmaayega, ab apne kufr ke badle azaab ka maza chakho.
ayahs.35: Pas (aye Paighambar!) tum aisa sabr karo jaisa sabr aali-himmat Rasoolon ne kiya aur un ke liye (azaab talab karne mein) jaldi na karo, yeh jis din is azaab ko dekh lenge jis ka waada diye jaate hain to (yeh maaloom hone lagega ke) din ki ek ghadi hi (dunya mein) thehre the, yeh hai paighaam pahuncha dena, pas badkaaron ke siwa koi halaak na kiya jaayega.
